text.p: Monsanto Co said on Tuesday it named Steve Stetz to the new position of corporate vice president, mergers and acquisitions, effective immediately.
Stetz, 54, will be responsible for managing the investment banking relationships for mergers and acquisitions for the company worldwide.
In addition, Stetz will become a member of the company's operations council, Monsanto said in a statement. He will report to Monsanto senior vice president and chief financial officer Robert Hoffman.
Most recently, Stetz was corporate vice president, financial planning and analysis.
Monsanto produces chemicals, pharmaceuticals, plastics, fibers and NutraSweet sweetener.
Shares of Monsanto closed up 1/2 to 37.
